thread:
alex (infra): Heads-up — APAC telemetry ramped down overnight for ~6h due to partial egress outage on cluster-az3. Some usage logs dropped before retry.
marie (capacity): Ugh. That window overlaps our daily sampling for GPU-hours. Forecast ingestion likely undercounts APAC by a few percent. Do we have a coverage metric to correct?
jia (sre): Right now the agent retries but the egress path returned 502 for a subset; we saw ~12% packet loss to telemetry collector between 03:10-09:20 UTC. Attachments in logs: `ERR_EGRESS_502` spikes.
sofia (data-eng): I pulled the parquet shards — there are gaps in usage_events partition for apac/*/2026-03-17T03-08. We can compute a telemetry_coverage ratio by comparing request counts to router-metrics. Quick SQL: ```
SELECT region, date, SUM(router_requests) AS router, SUM(usage_events) AS events, 1.0*SUM(usage_events)/NULLIF(SUM(router_requests),0) AS coverage
FROM daily_sampler
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY region, date;
```
marie (capacity): Nice. Can we create an adjusted metric for forecast pipeline — something like `effective_gpu_hours_adj` = raw_gpu_hours / coverage? That would inflate APAC estimates to account for missing logs.
sofia (data-eng): I can add a lightweight correction step in the ingestion DAG: if coverage < 0.9, apply a smoothing prior (0.92) to avoid giant spikes: `adjusted = raw_hours / max(coverage, 0.92)`. Will submit a PR.
jia (sre): Also we shouldtag the affected window so the downstream dashboards show adjustments and not stealthy anomalies. I can add an incident note and a `telemetry-bot` annotation.
telemetry-bot: Incident recorded: TELE-502-APAC-20260317. Affected shards: apac-az3-*(03:10-09:20 UTC). Auto-replay scheduled: false (manual review required).
alex (infra): For capacity planning we need a hedge: mark +8% GPU reserve for APAC for the next 72h while we reconcile. Marie, can you convert that into a temporary SLA reserve line for the hedging dashboard?
marie (capacity): Will do. I'll add a `capacity_hedge` tag to the forecast as `{region: apac, multiplier: 1.08, window: 72h, reason: telemetry gap}`. Will also notify finance about short-term commit risk.
product-ops: Quick question — will this change customer-facing limits or just internal forecast numbers?
alex (infra): Internal only for now — we won't expose anything to tenants. It's to avoid underprovisioning autoscale buckets.
sofia (data-eng): PR opened: `data/ingest/2026-03-17/coverage-correction` with unit tests. I added a small simulation comparing raw vs adjusted over Q4 patterns; APAC bias looks consistent with sample-rate drops during upgrades.
marie (capacity): After reconcile, we should mark the forecast datapoints with `data_quality: adjusted_telemetry` so ops knows which points are synthetic.
jia (sre): I fixed the egress routing rule causing 502s; pushing an ordered rollout to az3 now. I'll follow up if any replays succeed.
alex (infra): Thanks. Action items: 1) sofia PR + tests (ETA 2h) 2) marie add hedge to dashboard (ETA 1h) 3) jia confirm replay or mark manual replay (ETA 3h) 4) alex will update on-call runbook to include telemetry-coverage check. Ping me once done. :thumbsup:
sofia (data-eng): starting the change. will post PR link when ready.
marie (capacity): hedging line added to viz, flagged as temporary.
jia (sre): egress fix deployed to az3 canary. monitoring for `ERR_EGRESS_502` resumed.
telemetry-bot: Replay suggestion: run `replay_tool --region apac --from 2026-03-17T03:00 --to 2026-03-17T09:30 --shard az3` if manual approval given.
alex (infra): OK closing out here — we'll keep the hedged reserves in place until the replay & reconciliation confirms numbers. Thanks all.
